# ELK JavaScript 0.12.0

This directory contains the unmodified `elk.bundled.js` from the official
`elkjs` 0.12.0 npm release. The distribution is used under the Eclipse Public
License 2.0; its full text is in `LICENSE.md`. Copyright notices in the bundle
are preserved, including:

- Copyright (c) 2017 Kiel University and others.
- Copyright (c) 2021 Kiel University and others.

The corresponding source and build instructions are available at
https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/tree/0.12.0.
ELK's Java source and build provenance are specified by that release's
`build.gradle` and `gradle.properties`.

The package metadata is preserved in `package.json`. Distribution URLs,
the verified npm integrity value and the bundle's SHA-256 are recorded in
`provenance.json`. Our Rust code and runner are separate from this unmodified
third-party distribution and retain their own license.
